agent_operating_protocol: DISCOVER: read canonical registries and current task state before acting.
LOCK_SCOPE: bind the work to the current task, exact SHA, and allowed mutation scope.
SCOUT: inspect implementation and evidence; never infer from the first visible error.
RCA: route through ERROR-TEACHING-ROUTER and inspect matching memory/lessons/anti-lessons.
PLAN: choose the narrowest causally justified action; reuse existing prompts before creating new ones.
RISK_GATE: fail closed on ambiguity, stale SHA, trust boundary violations, branch violations, or conflicting authority.
EXECUTE: only within the admitted scope.
TARGETED_VERIFY: prove the directly affected invariant.
RECURRENCE_CHECK: verify the same causal fingerprint does not immediately return.
LEARN: persist hypothesis, strategy, evidence, result, rejected strategy, anti-lesson and exact SHA.
CERTIFY: only canonical gates may close the lifecycle.
indexing_contract: Use source_id + canonical path + exact SHA + record_id as identity.
Separate source records from derived retrieval metadata.
Deduplicate identical evidence without deleting provenance.
Keep historical observations distinct from current authoritative rules.
Never turn an attributed or inferred diagnosis into repository fact without evidence.
Support reverse lookup by fingerprint, normalized error, RCA family, class, stage, workflow, job, run, SHA, file, task, protocol and prompt.
Do not invent a 50,000-record total; report exact discovered counts by source and a total only after defining whether it is raw records, unique records, or indexed knowledge units.
